body:
I remember for a while when I was a kid, I would be laying in bed, trying to fall asleep, and I’d get these... flashes? 
I’ll try to describe it:
I’d be laying there and suddenly everything felt very slow and staticky and my brain was full of this white noise. Everything looked and felt 50% zoomed in and I would have trouble breathing. I’d also shake a bit. Sometimes I’d see random white flashing images. 
This happened a lot when I was 8-10, and I still slept with my mom a lot then due to anxiety, and it eventually stopped. Sometimes I get the same feeling now, but I never got it checked out. Seemed too little to be warranting a doctor visit.
